caption:
Lulu lifts a little one dozens of times a day, and by dinner her lower back feels heavy.

Toddlers get heavy fast, and it's easy to always carry them on the same hip. Holding a load close to your body is usually easier on the back. Clinical Pilates can help build the hip and trunk strength that supports all that lifting.

Hybi's 1-minute move: glute bridge, hold 3 seconds, 10 reps, once a day. Swap carrying sides often. Stop if pain gets worse or your leg tingles.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness or weakness, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Come and see us at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio
